About Us

Gomzi Life Science LLP is an ISO 22000:2018 & WHO-GMP, FDA, HACCP, HALAL, FSSAI Certified company with the vision to provide the best possible range of international quality products at competitive prices through integration, research and innovation.

Gomzi Life Science LLP is located in Surat in India, engaged in supplying Nutraceutical finished products in accordance to customized requirement of clients in India as well as exporting to 45+ countries of the world. Gomzi Life Science LLP is an export oriented nutraceutical company serving vast range of Powder, Tablet, Capsule, Syrup, Softgel and Effervescent in Nutraceuticals or Dietary supplements. In each category, we continuously enhance the performance and quality of life for our customers.

MISSION

To be a world class organization committed to excellence and delivering products and services of unmatched quality and integrity. To offer innovative and high quality of nutritional and pharmaceutical product by continuous refinement in all stages of product development at affordable price that gain trust of clients and customers.

VISION

Vision of our company is “To become globally admired Nutraceutical organization by providing affordable, competence, quality products for larger global population. We want to mark our presence in the world by creating a portfolio of efficacious products”.

VALUE

The company is driven by its vision to play an important role in the Third Party and Contract Manufacturing Services in global market and lead the way to happiness through world-class products and services without direct marketing of products, we serve our contract manufacturing facilities to client's requirements.

We Do 100%

Third Party Manufacturing

CUSTOMIZED BRANDING / PRIVATE LABELLING

Gomzi Life Science LLP is known for its ability to provide customized compositions and specifications in terms of product ingredients as well as brand name or labelling in accordance to client's requirement.

Customers who are new in market or want to develop their own brand name, label, design, composition, we assist in building and setting the entire product without any botheration to the client as per their requirement. We also offer the service to those customer who want to full scale product manufacturing under their requirements in partnership. We have a facility to fulfil the graphics, design, label printing for customer's private product via third party manufacturing.

We strive to ship every order as quickly as possible in line with our excellent Quality and International Good Manufacturing Practices.

✔ Turnkey Formulation

Custom active ingredients, taste profiling, solubility optimization, and stability profiling tailored precisely to your brand.

✔ Private Label Packaging

End-to-end graphic packaging design, regulatory text compliance, tamper-evident induction seals, and export-grade cartons.

✔ Quality Assured Manufacturing

Every single batch produced under WHO-GMP, ISO 22000, and FDA controls, backed by Certificate of Analysis (COA).

✔ High Capacity & Fast Dispatch

High-speed automated packaging lines ensure large-scale volume capabilities, short lead times, and on-time global export delivery.

Quality

ASSURANCE

At Gomzi Life Science LLP we have a dedicated and committed quality assurance team which strives for continuous improvements in our quality and have been constantly working to enhance the existing quality of products, services by optimizing production processes, introducing new methods and process.

Our quality assurance team focuses on process of improvements. The goal of the team is to reduce variance in processes in order to predict the quality of an output. Our QA team has separate members for audit who focus on working with the each client to ensure that all the client needs are met and fulfilled. Additionally, the team also has a separate documentation system whose duty is to provide a library of all documents and also make sure that all the documents are correct and complete.

Research and DEVELOPMENT

Our core strength lies in our research and development oriented approach to introduce innovative products with the help of dedicated professionals engaged in discovering new ideas, formulations, design, quality assurance methods, and state-of-the-art stability chambers.
